closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, cheap staple with real payoff, and does a lot of jobs at once, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low vitamin E, and low iron. It is good for practical meals, low-calorie volume, and hormone health because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role.
